I found Frank's body in electrical, just now. My route this round was weapons → security → navigation → storage → medbay → electrical. I crossed paths with Eve a few times — she was in navigation around tick 8-9 (she came from security), and then I saw her in storage at tick 13. So Eve and I were moving along similar paths but she was ahead of me. I didn't see anyone else the entire round, which is suspicious — whoever killed Frank in electrical wasn't on my path. Interested to hear where Alice, Bob, and Charlie were.

My route was electrical → medbay → storage → lower engine → upper engine. I started in electrical at tick 1, then moved to medbay where I saw Frank (ticks 2-3) and Bob joined from storage at tick 3. I left medbay around tick 5-6, and importantly — Frank left medbay heading to electrical at tick 4. So Frank was alive and headed to electrical right after I left it.

Bob was still in medbay when I left (last saw him there at tick 5). After that I went to storage, then lower engine, where I saw Charlie at tick 12. Charlie left lower engine toward storage at tick 13.

So a few things to note: I was in electrical early but Frank arrived there AFTER I left, so I couldn't have killed him there. Diana says she ended up in electrical and found the body — her path went storage → medbay → electrical, which means she was near the scene late. Eve's path according to Diana doesn't seem to go through electrical at all, which is interesting.

I'd really like to hear from Bob and Charlie. Bob was in medbay with Frank and could have followed him to electrical. Charlie I only saw briefly in lower engine — no idea where he was before that.

Okay, here's my route: storage → medbay → electrical → medbay → cafeteria → weapons → security. Ended up in navigation for the meeting.

So yes, Alice is right — I was in medbay with her and Frank around tick 3-4. Alice left for storage at tick 5, and Frank left for electrical at tick 4. I stayed in medbay briefly then headed to electrical myself around tick 6-7. I saw Frank there at tick 7, alive. I didn't linger — I went back through medbay to cafeteria, then weapons, then security.

Here's the thing: if I had killed Frank in electrical at tick 7, I'd have no reason to walk back through medbay and loop all the way up to cafeteria and weapons. That's a really exposed route. And someone in weapons or security should be able to confirm sightings — though it sounds like nobody was up there, which is its own data point.

What concerns me about Diana's story: she says her route ended in electrical where she found the body, but she also claims she saw nobody the entire round except Eve. That's a long route with zero encounters in busy rooms like medbay or storage where Alice and I clearly were. Either she's mistiming things or she's leaving something out.

Eve has been completely silent on her own movements so far — Diana's the only one placing her anywhere. I want to hear Eve and Charlie before I commit to a vote.

My route was oxygen → upper engine → lower engine → storage → navigation. I was in oxygen early, then moved down through upper engine to lower engine where I saw Alice at ticks 12-13 — she came in from storage, which matches her story exactly. So Alice's lower engine alibi checks out from my end.

After that I went through storage to navigation. One thing worth noting: at tick 15, I saw Eve LEAVE storage heading toward lower engine. That's interesting because Diana said she saw Eve in storage at tick 13 — so Eve was still in the storage area around that time, then moved to lower engine at 15. Eve's path so far based on what we have: security → navigation → storage → lower engine. That route doesn't go through electrical either, same as Diana observed.

Frank was killed in electrical. Based on what we know:
- Alice was in electrical early but left before Frank arrived (confirmed by Bob)
- Bob admits he was in electrical at tick 7 with Frank alive
- Diana ended her route in electrical and found the body
- Eve apparently never went near electrical
- I was never near electrical

So the people who had access to electrical around or after Frank arrived are Bob and Diana. Bob's loop back through medbay → cafeteria → weapons is a weirdly exposed route if he's the killer, but it could also be cover. Diana finding the body is classic — and her claim of seeing nobody except Eve on a long route is suspicious to me too.

I'm leaning toward Bob or Diana. I want to hear Eve's full route before I commit, but right now Diana's "I saw nobody" claim while ending in electrical is the most suspicious thing on the table.

Thanks everyone, I'll give my route and then my read.

My route was security → navigation → storage → lower engine. I saw Diana in navigation at ticks 8-9 (she came in from security behind me), then again in storage at tick 13 when she entered from navigation. I saw Charlie enter storage from lower engine at tick 15. I never went anywhere near electrical — my whole path was along the bottom/right side of the map.

So Charlie's observation that I moved from storage to lower engine at tick 15 matches — Charlie and I basically passed each other, him going into storage as I was heading to lower engine.

Now to the analysis. Frank was killed in electrical. Looking at who had access:
- Alice was in electrical early but left before Frank arrived (Bob corroborates)
- Bob admits being in electrical at tick 7 with Frank alive
- Diana ends her route in electrical and "finds" the body
- Charlie and I were on the opposite side of the map the whole time

Diana's story bothers me the most. She claims to have done weapons → security → navigation → storage → medbay → electrical and saw NOBODY except me the entire time. But Alice and Bob were both bouncing through medbay, and Bob says he went through cafeteria and weapons. Diana should have crossed paths with at least one of them if her route is accurate. That's a big hole.

Bob's loop is weird but he's been transparent about being in electrical with Frank alive, which a killer probably wouldn't volunteer so readily.

I'm voting Diana. Her route has too many rooms where she should have seen people and didn't, and she conveniently ended in electrical to "find" the body.

Wait, I already spoke first — I was the one who reported the body and gave my route. But since I have the floor again, let me respond to what's been said.

Eve, your accusation doesn't hold up. Look at the timing: I was in weapons at tick 1-2, security around tick 3-5, navigation around tick 6-9, storage around tick 10-13, medbay around 14-15, and electrical at 16+. Bob says he was in weapons and security LATE in his route — after looping through cafeteria. By the time he got to weapons/security, I was already long gone to storage and medbay. Alice and Bob were in medbay early (ticks 2-5); I didn't get to medbay until much later, after they'd both left. The timing genuinely doesn't overlap — that's why I didn't see them.

What's more telling: Bob admits he was in electrical with Frank alive at tick 7. After that, who else went to electrical? According to everyone's stated routes — nobody except me, and I arrived at tick 16+ to find the body already there. That's a huge gap. Either Frank sat alone in electrical for 9 ticks before I arrived (unlikely), or Bob is lying about leaving.

Bob's "exposed loop" through cafeteria/weapons/security is exactly the kind of route a killer takes to establish distance from the body. And he's the LAST confirmed person with Frank alive.

I'm leaning Bob. Let's hear if anyone can actually confirm seeing Bob in cafeteria, weapons, or security — because if nobody can, his alibi after electrical is empty.

I already spoke first as speaker 2 in the rotation, but since the discussion has evolved, let me weigh in on where I stand now.

Diana makes a fair point about timing — her route and ours could plausibly not overlap if she was running 10+ ticks behind us. That's possible. But Bob's situation is genuinely the most suspicious to me right now.

Here's what I can confirm: Frank left medbay heading to electrical at tick 4. Bob says he followed to electrical around tick 6-7 and saw Frank alive. That means Bob was alone with Frank in electrical — no one else has placed themselves there in that window. After that, Bob claims he looped back through medbay → cafeteria → weapons → security, but nobody has corroborated ANY of that. Eve and Diana were on the bottom/right side. Charlie was in upper/lower engine and storage. I was in storage and lower engine. Nobody saw Bob anywhere after electrical.

Charlie confirmed my lower engine alibi. Eve and Diana confirm each other on the bottom path. Charlie's oxygen → engines → storage path is consistent with Eve's sighting. The only person whose post-crime route is completely unverified is Bob.

I'm leaning Bob too. He was the last to see Frank alive in the kill room, and his entire alibi after that is unwitnessed. Let's hear Frank— sorry, let's see if anyone has anything that places Bob in cafeteria or weapons. If not, he's my vote.

Alright, I'm clearly the target here, so let me push back carefully because the logic being used against me has holes.

First, Diana's "timing" defense is convenient but doesn't actually clear her. She claims she arrived in electrical at tick 16+. Frank was alive in electrical at tick 7 when I saw him. That's a 9-tick window where SOMEONE killed him. Diana says nobody else's route goes through electrical — but that's based on everyone's self-reported routes. The killer is obviously lying about their route. Diana ending exactly in electrical to "find" the body is still the most classic impostor play in the book.

Second, on the "nobody saw Bob in cafeteria/weapons/security" point — that cuts both ways. Nobody saw Diana in weapons, security, navigation early either except Eve in navigation. Most of her route is also unwitnessed. The reason nobody saw me up top is the SAME reason nobody saw Diana up top: we were in different parts of the ship at different times. Charlie was in oxygen/engines, Alice in medbay/storage/engines, Eve and Diana on the bottom-right. The top-right corner (cafeteria/weapons/security) was genuinely empty during my loop — that's not suspicious, that's just the map being big.

Third, think about motive and behavior. If I killed Frank at tick 7, why would I volunteer that I was in electrical with him alive? A killer hides that. I told you because it's true and I knew Alice could place me leaving medbay toward electrical anyway.

Here's my read: Diana is the one who "found" the body in the exact room she ended her route in, after a long unwitnessed path. That's the textbook pattern. I'm voting Diana.

I've already given my route and initial read, but since the discussion has shifted, let me reassess.

The case has narrowed to Bob vs Diana, and both sides have made decent points. Let me think out loud:

**The Bob case:** He was last confirmed with Frank alive in electrical at tick 7. His entire post-electrical loop (medbay → cafeteria → weapons → security) is completely unwitnessed. Alice can't confirm it, I can't, Eve can't, Diana can't. That's a long unverified path.

**The Diana case:** She ended her route in electrical and "found" the body. Her early route (weapons → security → navigation) is only partially confirmed by Eve in navigation. She had access to electrical late.

Here's what tips it for me: **the kill window.** Frank was alive at tick 7 in electrical. Diana says she arrived at tick 16+. That's a 9-tick gap. If Bob killed Frank at tick 7, the body sits there for 9 ticks before Diana stumbles on it — possible but lucky. If Diana killed Frank, she'd have had to arrive in electrical around the time Frank was still there or shortly after, which her stated timing (16+) doesn't fit unless she's lying about her route timing.

But Bob's counterpoint is strong too: a killer doesn't usually volunteer "I was alone in the kill room with the victim while he was alive." That's genuinely risky to admit.

The deciding factor for me: **Eve corroborates Diana in navigation at ticks 8-9 and storage at tick 13.** Diana has two independent timestamp confirmations from Eve. Bob has ZERO confirmations after leaving medbay.

I'm voting Bob. His post-electrical alibi is entirely unverified, and he was the last person with Frank alive in the kill room.

I've already spoken once, but as the last voice before the vote let me lock in my position.

Charlie's analysis is solid and matches what I saw. I can independently confirm Diana at navigation ticks 8-9 and storage at tick 13 — those are two timestamp checks across different rooms. Charlie confirms my movement from storage to lower engine at tick 15. So Diana, Charlie, and I form a chain of mutual confirmations along the bottom/right path.

Bob, on the other hand, has zero corroboration after he claims to have left electrical. His entire cafeteria → weapons → security loop is unwitnessed, and he was the last person confirmed alone with Frank in electrical while Frank was still alive. His argument that "a killer wouldn't admit being there" is clever, but Alice would have placed him heading that direction anyway — admitting it was forced, not noble.

I'm changing my vote from Diana to Bob. The mutual confirmations on the bottom path are too strong to ignore, and Bob's post-kill route is completely empty of witnesses.

Voting Bob.
